value.rationale: Quadratic two-step commutative associative algebras form a canonical unbounded family intrinsically classified by the Witt type of their socle multiplication form. The complete Nijenhuis solution space, exact finite-field rank polynomial, one missing middle rank in every nonsplit even dimension, and parity-sensitive reduced components constitute natural structural and arithmetic information beyond the familiar three-dimensional case. The result is not a renamed known small case or an arbitrary finite sample.
